CREATE TABLE "reconciliation_approvals" (
	"id" serial PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"owner_id" varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	"canonical_report" "bytea" NOT NULL,
	"report_format_version" integer NOT NULL,
	"algorithm_version" varchar(100) NOT NULL,
	"report_sha256" varchar(64) NOT NULL,
	"signed_token_evidence" text NOT NULL,
	"preview_cutoff" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	"source_fingerprint" text NOT NULL,
	"approving_actor_id" varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	"approved_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	"approved_source_ids" text NOT NULL,
	"account_corrections_cents" text NOT NULL,
	"before_component_totals_cents" text NOT NULL,
	"after_component_totals_cents" text NOT NULL,
	"expected_delta_cents" bigint NOT NULL,
	"backup_evidence_reference" text NOT NULL,
	"backup_cutoff" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	"rollback_deadline" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	"state" varchar(10) DEFAULT 'approved' NOT NULL,
	"execution_idempotency_key" varchar(255),
	"execution_payload_sha256" varchar(64),
	"executed_at" timestamp with time zone,
	"reversed_at" timestamp with time zone,
	CONSTRAINT "uq_reconciliation_approvals_owner_digest" UNIQUE("owner_id","report_sha256"),
	CONSTRAINT "uq_reconciliation_approvals_owner_id_id" UNIQUE("owner_id","id"),
	CONSTRAINT "uq_reconciliation_approvals_owner_idempotency_key" UNIQUE("owner_id","execution_idempotency_key"),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_reconciliation_approvals_execution_binding" CHECK (((execution_idempotency_key IS NULL) AND (execution_payload_sha256 IS NULL)) OR ((execution_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL) AND (execution_payload_sha256 IS NOT NULL))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_reconciliation_approvals_state" CHECK ((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['approved'::character varying, 'executed'::character varying, 'reversed'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying])::text[]))
);
